summary: Iteration 9 verified. New GET /api/diagnostics endpoint returns 200 with correct shape (when, system{platform,python,mock_mode=true}, env{5 flags}, checks[6], all_ok=true). All 6 required checks present by name (MongoDB, Gemini OCR, Playwright / Chromium, GPay account pool, WhatsApp service, Email service (Resend)); Playwright row reports 'skipped (mock mode)'. Regression smoke (8 prior endpoints) all pass. Backend restart clean, no import errors. Dockerfile.backend change is invisible to preview as expected (no docker build in preview).

Email service (Resend) — key present (send not attempted here to avoid spam)
critical_code_review_comments: Diagnostics endpoint runs checks sequentially with `await check(...)` — could be gathered in parallel with asyncio.gather for faster response, but current serial execution keeps error attribution clean and finished in ~2s (acceptable).

The Playwright check in live mode actually launches Chromium which is expensive; consider caching a browser instance or only doing a version check. Currently guarded by mock-mode so not a preview concern.
In UI, copyDiag() should surface a toast/tooltip on clipboard permission failure so users know when the copy silently failed (currently only console log).
